shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击的干净合规主图，完整呈现廓形与领口
一秒传达宽松落肩、上身不挑人的核心卖点
放大旧T恤起球、领口松垮、闷热粘身的穿着痛点
代入日常通勤与街头出行场景，强化百搭气质
用纱线织纹与缝边工艺特写证明面料质感
侧影双栏对比证明领口与肩线久穿不变形
平铺整件呈现剪裁与车缝位置，消除细节疑虑
同版型多色一览，让买家快速锁定颜色
以气势机位收口促单，留出按钮位承接行动

style.backgroundSystem: oat-apricot paper sweep #F5EDE4 for packshots and variants, dusty rose #E7D1C6 for benefit and comparison panels, ink charcoal #221D1A flat field for flat-lay and pain panels, terracotta clay #B07450 for scene and closing
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and blank label cards in a single accent tone
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio light with a front-left key and fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars except deliberate pain-panel contrast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent relaxed street menswear tee visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of oat-apricot #F5EDE4, dusty rose #E7D1C6, terracotta clay #B07450 and ink charcoal #221D1A with no fifth hue; warm soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; matte paper sweep and raw cotton surface language; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with blank label cards; clean garment photography mixed with minimal blank infographic frames; stable centered garment scale on an invisible form; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes beyond the four locked tones
style.presentationRules: stable centered garment scale on an invisible form across the set, chest print area always preserved for the identity lock
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper sweep and raw cotton jersey surface language, no glossy laminates
